methodology.description: Public draft-helper PPR redraft board. Player value and market cost are intentionally kept separate. Rankings blend broad expert consensus, current projections, recent independent expert boards and material preseason/news context; ADP is treated as price rather than player quality. League scoring, roster construction, draft slot, drafted players, positional scarcity and next-pick pressure are applied by the client recommendation engine.
rankingInputs: FantasyPros 2026 PPR consensus and current real-time ADP checked Sept. 1
ESPN 2026 draft guide/current fantasy news checked Sept. 1
RotoWire Sept. 1 PPR rankings, player updates and ADP
Rotoworld/NBC Sports late-preseason rankings and player-news context checked through Sept. 1
Yahoo Sports, CBS, Fantasy Life and independent market sources checked through Sept. 1
methodology.marketInput: Current PPR ADP remains a separate market-price input, cross-checked across FantasyPros, Sleeper-market samples, Yahoo/CBS and other platform references. ADP is not used as a substitute for player value; large gaps remain when injury, availability, role uncertainty or expert disagreement justifies them.
newsInputs: Josh Jacobs is placed on the NFL Commissioner's Exempt List and cannot practice or play while on it. His public-helper value falls sharply despite still-elevated trailing ADP because the duration is unknown; Yahoo has moved him to No. 108 while RotoWire's Sept. 1 player rank remains around No. 54, so the disagreement band is intentionally enormous.

MarShawn Lloyd is added at No. 65 as Green Bay's projected starter while Jacobs is unavailable. Fantasy Life moved him into its top 65, while older RotoWire work had him around No. 133 before the Jacobs news. FantasyPros real-time ADP has surged to about 100 overall, nearly 48 picks in a week, so value and market price are kept separate.
The existing top-30 board remains broadly stable against Sept. 1 RotoWire, FantasyPros and ESPN work; no other player had enough new information to justify a comparable move today.
Puka Nacua remains No. 4 with a wider risk band because the NFL review remains unresolved; no new exempt-list action was announced for him as of Aug. 31.
Ashton Jeanty remains No. 23 with a wide range. The ankle is still viewed as short-term, but Week 1 remains uncertain and Mike Washington Jr. has been taking first-team work.
methodology.notes: Expert disagreement is preserved with expertHigh/expertLow ranges; unresolved injuries, discipline risk and genuine model disagreement can intentionally widen those ranges. Confidence reflects agreement plus news certainty, not ceiling. This file is used only by smhillis/sleeper-draft-helper-public and must not be copied into or used to modify Scott's personal Sleeper Draft Assistant.

players.news: Major downgrade. Jacobs is on the Commissioner's Exempt List and cannot practice or play while listed, with no firm return date.
